notes: This is a closed comparison of complete assisted systems, not a learned-motor model ranking. Astra8/8 ties the analytic expert; no improved motor control or causal RGB/depth/Hall use is established.

Original per-case native qualifiers are authoritative. Nullable force/plane extrema are not reported in this extract; raw 240Hz forces were measured and checked by the original qualifier, and raw traces remain private on Linux. Acceptance limits are not substituted as measured extrema. Source and physical gates remain unchanged.

All eight fixed scenarios per arm remain: two held-out identities x two known seated poses x R3/L3, independent home starts; not ten-point continuity, unseen poses or broad population/clinical/acoustic validation.

Post-run hardware observation is not an owner-generated execution receipt. Simulation-time playback omits API waiting; Codex CLI service wall, client observation/inference wall and unmeasured HTTP-only latency are distinct.
Raw arrays/body assets/weights/credentials are not bundled. Original pending/partial media receipts are immutable and separate postflight bindings document later qualifications.

The original whole summary remains diagnostic_only=true, formal_acceptance=false and training_accepted=false. Closure of this comparison does not promote benchmark episodes to training eligibility or full-project acceptance.
